title: From phone bookings to an online platform
summary: How a clinic reduced front-desk workload by moving appointments, reminders and records online.
challenge: All appointments were taken by phone and written in registers. Missed calls meant lost patients, and no-shows left doctors with empty slots.
solution: We built an online booking platform with doctor-wise schedules, WhatsApp reminders and a reception dashboard, and migrated existing patient records into a secure database.

results.label: Self-service bookings replace most phone calls
Single daily queue view for reception

title: One stock ledger across branches and online
summary: How a retailer stopped overselling by syncing branch stock with its online store.
challenge: Each branch tracked stock separately and the online store was updated by hand, causing oversold items and delayed deliveries.
solution: We introduced a central inventory ledger connected to billing in every branch and to the storefront, with low-stock alerts and branch-wise reports.

results.label: Stock updates in near real time

title: Tracking every lead from first click to site visit
summary: How a developer gained visibility into which campaigns produced actual site visits.
challenge: Leads arrived from calls, forms and portals into different places. Follow-ups were missed and campaign performance was guesswork.
solution: We connected the website, campaigns and a custom CRM so each lead carries its source, owner, follow-ups and status through to site visit.
